paper_title: Shining Light on the Dark Sector: Search for Axion-like Particles and Other New Physics in Photonic Final States with FASER
notes: FASER search for light long-lived particles decaying to photon pairs. Primary target is ALP coupled to W bosons (g_aWW), with reinterpretations including ALP-photon (g_agamma), ALP-gluon, U(1)_B gauge boson, up-philic scalar, and 2HDM. The paper does present world-leading constraints (1 observed event vs 0.44 background), but the provided content does not include numerical exclusion limit tables or readable contour data points in the (mass, coupling) plane. The primary coupling is actually g_aWW (ALP-W), not g_agamma; ALP-photon is a secondary reinterpretation. No extractable numerical limit data available in provided text. Confidence lowered due to multiple coupling types and absence of numerical data. | Vision: Lower boundary of the closed exclusion loop traced from the ALP-W plot (image 4). Y-axis is ALP coupling g_a [1/GeV], treated as AxionPhoton (g_aWW coupling). X-axis mass converted from MeV to eV (70 MeV=7e7 eV etc). The exclusion region is closed (loop); lower edge follows the observed limit (blue). Coupling is g_aWW (weak-boson coupling) rather than strictly photon coupling, hence moderate confidence. | Calibration: No calibration needed
